title: Buddy Petit's trumpet style
summary: Zardis describes Buddy's staff playing, melody, derby mute and quiet band, and compares him with Kid Howard and Bunk.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Buddy, Buddy's playing was great. Buddy wasn't, what you mean, what I call a high, you know, man that plays high. He doesn't play high at all. But what Buddy plays, he plays in the staff. You know what I mean? And when he play in the staff, I mean, so much melody and harmony through his music, you know what I mean? And he just, he just was wonderful. He got, he had a derby, a brown derby, and he put that derby on, you know, on his horn like that. And man, you talk about music, he'd make the music come out and then, he didn't have a loud band. The band wasn't loud. I mean, you could be playing and the people out there dancing, you could hear, you know, the footsteps, you know what I mean? Yeah, he was great.
Did he, did he have a good reputation? I mean, I mean, I mean, was he highly regarded by, by, by other musicians and other, and people who wanted him?

People liked it Buddy or plenty. They was crazy about Buddy. They was crazy about Buddy. They just say Buddy, sometime he just, you know what I mean, he just overdo it. Like any man would do when you get out with a bunch playing, he could drink, but he couldn't drink much, and at least a little bit of liquor he drank would, you know, would go to his head.
Can you, did, did he play anything like anybody you could mention, to give an idea of comparing him with anybody or anything?
No, there's nobody around who ever played like Buddy. Kid Howard used to try to imitate Buddy, but I mean, no. He never could. No.
Did he play anything like Bunk? Well, a little bit.

A little bit like Bunk, you know what I mean, but he's mostly in the staff. You see, sometimes Bunk used to go up a little bit, you know what I mean? Yeah. But Buddy never did go up there too much. He just stayed right down in the staff. Yeah.
